services.name: Oil change
services.blurb: The oil your engine's spec calls for, a new filter, and a look under the hood.

services.name: Tune-up and spark plugs
services.blurb: Plugs and coils checked for misfires that thin air makes easier to feel on the climb.

services.name: Engine and cabin air filters
services.blurb: Dirt roads to Eldorado and Cerrillos fill filters with red dust. We show you yours.

services.name: Wipers, belts and hoses
services.blurb: High sun cracks rubber fast. Blades, belts and hoses checked and swapped when they crack.

services.name: Coolant and fluid exchanges
services.blurb: Cold nights and warm days work coolant hard. Tested first, exchanged at your manual's interval.

services.name: Battery test and replacement
services.blurb: Cold mornings at seven thousand feet find weak batteries. A five-minute load test tells you first.

services.name: Tire rotation and pressure
services.blurb: Pressures reset for the big day-night swings, tires rotated, tread measured for the ski road.

services.name: Season checks
services.blurb: Before monsoon and before snow: wipers, battery, coolant, tires and lights in one visit.

proof.label: Sample

reviews.text: Every morning my tire light came on and by noon it was off. They explained the cold-night pressure swing, set them right, and the light stopped coming on.
reviews.name: Lucia M.

reviews.text: My wipers were split from the sun by June. They swapped them before the first monsoon storm on 285 and checked the washer fluid and the belts while they were there.
reviews.name: Daniel C.

reviews.text: They pulled my cabin filter and it was full of red dust from the road out to Cerrillos. Five minutes, and the car stopped smelling like a barn.
reviews.name: Ana V.

reviews.text: I drive up to Los Alamos every weekday and the car felt flat on the hill. They found one worn plug and a tired coil, replaced just those, and had it back by noon.
reviews.name: Peter G.

reviews.text: Battery tested weak in November. I would have been stuck in the ski basin lot. They replaced it while I had a coffee down the street.
reviews.name: Rosa T.

reviews.text: Season check before winter: coolant tested, new wiper blades, tires rotated. A short written list, with two things marked fine until spring.
reviews.name: Joaquin E.

reviews.text: Oil change on my lunch hour. They told me which oil my engine takes and why, and wrote the next one on the windshield sticker.
reviews.name: Mara S.

proof.guarantee: We tell you what's due at your mileage and your altitude, and what can wait.
